content:
I'd be happy to help fix a bug for you! However, I don't see any code or description of the bug in your message. Could you please provide:

1. The code that has the bug
2. A description of what the bug is (error messages, unexpected behavior, etc.)
3. What you expect the code to do instead
4. Any relevant context or environment information

Once you share these details, I'll be able to help you identify and fix the issue!
